broadcasts.description:
Chidagni 2026, The Fire of Consciousness Festival (16th edition)
Inauguration · Tuesday 6 October 2026 · Live from Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan, Mylapore, Chennai

This evening (all times IST; the stream opens at 4:45 pm):
5:00 pm  Welcome and lighting of the lamp
5:05 pm  Anugraha Bhashanam: Swami Shrihariprasad
      Founder and Managing Trustee, Sri Vishnu Mohan Foundation
5:10 pm  Chief Guest Address: Padma Shri Dr. Nalli Kuppuswami Chetti
      Chairman, Nalli Silks. Vice Chairman, Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan, Chennai Kendra.
5:15 pm  Address: Sri K. N. Ramaswamy
      Director, Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan, Chennai Kendra
5:20 pm  Inaugural Address: Sri K. Giridhara Sarma
      Disciple of Late Brahmasri Goda Venkateshwara Sastrigal
6:45 pm  Carnatic vocal concert: Vid. Ritvik Y V
      Violin: Vid. Parur M K Ananthabalasubramaniam
      Mridangam: Vid. Sriram Srinivasan
      Ghatam: Vid. Ganapathy

Venue: Mini Hall, 2nd Floor, Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan, East Mada Street, Mylapore, Chennai 600004. All are welcome.

Join on Zoom: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87692135267?pwd=UmNlTGhVVkhBdHpMM05aWkNSUXRwZz09
Meeting ID 876 9213 5267, password Krishna

Schedule, countdown and the stream for every evening: https://live.svmf.in/chidagni

The five evenings (IST):
Day 1, Tue 6 October: 5:00 pm Inauguration; 6:45 pm Carnatic vocal concert, Vid. Ritvik Y V
Day 2, Wed 7 October: 5:30 pm Discourse on “Sita Devi”, Dr. Priya Ramachandran; 6:45 pm Namasankirtanam, Dr. R. Ganesh and Party
Day 3, Thu 8 October: 5:30 pm Discourse on “Moksha-Pradayini”, Prof. K. Srinivasan; 6:45 pm Devotional music concert, Dr. Radha Bhaskar and disciples
Day 4, Fri 9 October: 6:00 pm Harikatha on “Meena Lochani, Paasha Mochani”, Kalarathna Vid. U. E. Sinddhuja
Day 5, Sat 10 October: 6:00 pm Carnatic violin concert, Kalaimamani, Kalasri, Tantri Gnana Tapasvi Dr. M. Narmadha

Jointly organised by Sri Vishnu Mohan Foundation, Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan (Chennai Kendra) and Sri Gnana Advaitha Peetam. The Sri Vishnu Mohan Foundation and Sri Gnana Advaitha Peetam are not-for-profit organisations guided by the philosophy of Her Holiness Sri Sathguru Swami Gnanananda Sarasvathi Ma.
Queries: Smt. Saraswati Janakiraman, +91 98415 98263
www.srisathguru.com · www.svmf.in
